Stated Claim / Post Context:
First US Detransition Clinic Opens In Texas Funded By Healthcare Fraud Settlement

‘The clinic is operational’

Actual Article Body:
Photo by Kent NISHIMURA / AFP via Getty Images

Texas just opened the country’s first-ever detransition clinic as part of a healthcare fraud settlement between the largest children’s hospital in the nation and the Texas Attorney General’s Office.

Texas Attorney General and Republican Senate nominee Ken Paxton announced Tuesday that Texas Children’s Hospital opened a Detransition Clinic to offer medical care and counseling for patients wanting to return to presenting as their biological sex and recover from sex change procedures they underwent. The Attorney General’s Office — which previously charged the hospital with billing Texas Medicaid for “unallowable and illegal ‘gender-transition’ interventions” — required Texas Children’s to pay a $10 million dollar settlement in addition to building the clinic and amending its bylaws, according to a press release from the office.

“I will continue to ensure that this clinic provides the care and support that victims of the radical left’s gender ideology deserve,” Paxton said in the release. “Together, we will protect our children and defeat the dangerous ideology that has inflicted irreversible harm on innocent kids.”

“First and foremost, patients and families are at the center of all we do and we will always provide the highest standard of care, including through this clinic, which formalizes the supportive, multidisciplinary services we have and will continue to deliver,” Texas Children’s said in a statement to the Daily Caller News Foundation. “Given the multidisciplinary approach, care may be delivered in multiple locations, depending on individual patient needs. All services provided will be within our hospital’s existing licensure and scope. Services will include Endocrinology, Surgery, Primary Care, Fertility Counseling, Psychiatry, Psychology, Social Work/Case Management and Speech Pathology.”“The clinic is operational and we are complying with all requirements in the settlement agreement,” the statement added.

The Texas Attorney General’s Office did not immediately respond to DCNF’s request for comment.

BREAKING: The nation’s first-ever Detransition Clinic is now open as a result of my historic settlement with Texas Children’s Hospital. https://t.co/f2DfFGRL37

Texas Children’s will fully fund the Detransition Clinic’s services for its first five years, so patients may receive care at no cost, and to promote the clinic on its website, according to the Tuesday release. This clinic will provide detransition-related medical care for patients through age 21 and also offer detransition-related obstetric and gynecologic care for older adult patients.

Paxton first started investigating the hospital in 2023, after leaked documents showed the hospital gave still children sex-change surgeries and hormones — despite telling the public it had stopped doing so. Paxton’s efforts and his stance on banning gender-transitions have been a key part of his campaign for Senate. (RELATED: Scandal-Ridden Hospital To Open First US ‘Detransition’ Clinic In Historic Legal Settlement)

The announcement came exactly one week before the Lone Star State’s hotly-contested Senate race between Paxton and Democratic nominee James Talarico, which the nonpartisan Cook Political Report rates as a toss up.

Talarico’s stance on child sex changes have come under scrutiny during the campaign — with him stating on a June podcast episode that he opposes “gender reassignment surgeries for minors.” However, on a separate podcast appearance three years earlier, he indicated that he loved “trans children” when asked to name something he loved.
